correctness.rationale: Two finite self-contained certificates partition all 192 admissible seven-symbol words into eight disjoint 21-cycles and twelve edges, bounding any distance-two code by 92; 92 explicit pairwise-compatible words attain the bound. The 48-state five-symbol analogue uses two disjoint 15-cycles, nine edges and a 23-word witness. verify.py and independently encoded alternate.py both succeeded against actual certificate files. All pairwise edges, closure edges, membership, nonoverlap and erasure puncturing are tested; the argument needs no unbounded search.

value.rationale: The exact seven-symbol capacity is a motivated natural missing benchmark in homopolymer-free error detection and labeled path recoloring; the result strictly improves the general prior Hamiltonicity-derived 96-word upper bound and reveals an explicit odd-cycle obstruction. The length-five boundary is included as a coherent comparison, not an arbitrary separate novelty claim.
